description: ttmu (tt muonic molecule) formation rate, x phi x c_t
conditions: x phi x c_t; liquid-tritium-normalized; tt side-branch formation out of the tmu pool
validity_range: liquid; c_t~0.5 D/T and pure tritium
notes: blocked: not normalizable from the in-hand primary; pending acquisition of the Matsuzaki/Bom tt-fusion formation-rate tables (Muon Catal. Fusion / JINR). The in-hand primary is JINR preprint E15-2008-99: Table 1, Combined column, gives lambda_ttmu = 2.84 +- 0.32 (10^6 s^-1) for liquid tritium at 22.5 K and 1.25 LHD (sec. 2.3, p.6). Two of its passages read that rate differently. Systematic (a) on p.13 includes the 1.3% uncertainty in the tritium density in the total error for lambda_ttmu, as a rate divided by the density would need; Eq. (2), lambda_C = lambda_f*lambda_ttmu/(lambda_f + lambda_ttmu), returns the cycling rate stated on p.13 (2.4 us^-1) from the Table 1 values with lambda_ttmu unscaled, as the rate in the target. Read as in-target, the value in this row's x-phi-x-c_t convention is the tabled rate divided by 1.25 (c_t ~ 1: less than 1% deuterium and protium, p.7); read as density-normalized, it is the tabled rate. The two readings differ by more than the quoted uncertainty, so the row ships 0.0 (tt channel inert). include_loss_channels=True with a 0.0 rate is a no-op.

description: tt-branch effective muon-loss fraction (mu sticking to He in tt fusion)

The tt CHANNEL remains inert because its formation rate lambda_ttmu is 0.0 (blocked; see that row); this fraction is recorded for the re-attribution once lambda_ttmu is normalized.
